item.title: Hokkaido Dairy Guide: Milk, Cheese, Soft Cream & Farms
item.description: Hokkaido’s cool climate and vast pastures make it Japan’s dairy heartland, and its rich milk is the foundation of some of the country’s most beloved treats. Travellers come for the famously creamy soft-serve ice cream, fresh milk and drinking yoghurt, artisan cheese and butter, and decadent sweets like Hokkaido cheesecake and caramels. Farm cafés and cheese factories across the island — especially in the Tokachi region — let you taste it all at the source, and even try your hand at cheese or butter making.
